project.description: Scenarios 07 and 54 pin qualifier keying for scalar members - one @Nonbinding, one binding. Neither uses an array-valued member, and that was the gap issue 158 found: IpKey compared member values with Objects.deepEquals but hashed them with value.hashCode(), which for an array is an identity hash. Java's annotation proxy clones array members on every access to keep the annotation immutable, so the hash was not even stable for one key object, let alone equal across two equal ones. The candidate set is hash-based, so both injection points below survived it, two synthetic beans with equivalent qualifiers were registered, and the deployment failed with AmbiguousResolutionException on OpenWebBeans and WELD-001409 on Weld. This scenario pins the shared mock that a correct hash produces, and the @Nonbinding array member that must still be ignored.
project.name: jawelte tests/cdi-module scenario 67: array-valued qualifier members key correctly
